refnamediv.refpurpose: Subtracts an amount of days, months, years, hours, minutes and seconds

refentry.refsect1:
&reftitle.errors;
If an unsupported operation is attempted, such as using a DateInterval object representing relative time specifications such as next weekday, a DateInvalidOperationException is thrown.

&reftitle.notes;
When the subtraction crosses a transition of the time zone, such as the start or the end of daylight saving time, the result depends on where interval comes from: an interval created from an ISO 8601 string subtracts the elapsed time in wall clock units, while an interval returned by DateTime::diff is subtracted in civil units. The same nominal interval can therefore give results one hour apart.
